description: Modern warfare increasingly relies on smart, autonomous weapons designed to disable an adversary’s ability to retaliate. description: A Delhi man was arrested for masquerading as a Himachal Police officer after he contacted a Gurgaon SHO to restore power to his wife's shop. Presenting himself as SP Chandan Singh, he attempted to exert undue influence. However, the police caught onto his ruse, leading to a case being registered. He later confessed to the impersonation when the power situation was confirmed.
title: Delhi man poses as SP, invokes DGP’s name to restore electricity to wife’s shop

author: FARYAL RUMI, KSHITIZ, ADWITIYA DEB
description: Advocates allege nearly 200 students were detained after protests demanding the education minister's resignation. Many detainees, including minors, remained in custody for over 24 hours. Police stated 86 protesters were sent to judicial custody and others released on bonds. Violence during protests led to multiple FIRs and arrests across several districts. Several government vehicles were vandalized and police personnel sustained injuries.
title: Bihar bandh violence: Siwan cop suspended for firing AK-47; 200 NEET protesters detained

author: SANTOSH SONAWANE
description: Tragedy struck in Jalalpur village as a 19-year-old girl reportedly took her own life on Saturday. Authorities discovered a note revealing her distress over disappointing NEET re-examination results, where she scored 166, falling short of the 177 needed. This heartbreaking incident comes just weeks after another NEET-associated death in Nashik. Students are reminded to stay resilient and persevere through academic challenges.
title: 'I am an average student': 19-yr-old ends life over low NEET marks in Maharashtra
